title: A Simple Doxastic Deontic Logic for Norm-Guided Decision Making
reasoning: The paper proposes a formal doxastic deontic logic framework for norm-guided decision making in autonomous systems. While it formalizes normative and ethical reasoning using logic (e.g., deontic logic, utilitarian principles), it does not evaluate or benchmark morals or ethics, nor does it apply these concepts to Large Language Models or NLP systems.
